claims.text: Berylla married Balbo Baggins. Their children were Mungo, Pansy, Ponto, Largo, and Lily.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "Boffin of the Yale"

claims.text: Berylla's brother was Basso, who is said to have "gone to sea" in at the age of 26.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings (50th Anniv. Ed.), Appendix C, "Bolger of Budgeford", p. 1102
